text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
While I'm walking through the<n>shopping district one
evening...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Oh! Trainer! Your timing couldn't be<n>better!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Could you draw this for me? I've got<n>to get to work
soon!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She forcefully jams a slip of paper<n>into the palm of
my hand. I take a<n>closer look and see...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yep! I've got my sights set on the<n>second prize—a
bushel of carrots!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: The line is over there! I'm counting on<n>you!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I look in the direction Ines Fujin is<n>pointing and see
a long line of<n>families who have just finished
shopping.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Step right up and try your luck with<n>our New Year's
raffle! This year's<n>grand prize is a hot spring
vacation<n>for two!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
First-prize winners get a deluxe carrot<n>hamburger
steak! Second-prize<n>winners get a bushel of
carrots! And<n>third-prize winners can take home a
single carrot!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Don't let this opportunity pass you<n>by! Get a ticket
now and spin for your<n>chance to win!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I hand over the ticket I got from Ines<n>Fujin and
eagerly turn the handle on<n>the raffle device.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
A small plastic ball drops from the<n>tumbler's
opening...

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Holy mackerel! We've got ourselves<n>a grand-prize
winner! Come and get<n>the coupon for your hot
spring<n>vacation! Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Whaaaaat?! It's actually possible to<n>win the grand
prize?!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Share some of that good luck with<n>me, will ya?!
Next time I get a chance,<n>I'll win myself a grand
prize, too!
choice_data_list: Huh, but what about this coupon?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I'll let you keep it. You were the one<n>who won it,
after all.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I wouldn't feel right taking it after the<n>fact. C'mon,
hurry up and put it in<n>your pocket.
choice_data_list: But it was your ticket in the first place...
But it was your ticket in the first place...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I said it's fine. Just accept it!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Why not?!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... Just take it already,Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Arrrgh! Wait, I've got an idea! How<n>about this?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Let's keep this coupon in reserve for<n>now! Once
we find a time that fits<n>both our schedules, we'll go.
End of<n>story. Sound good?
choice_data_list: I can get on board with that!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Phew... We've finally got that sorted,<n>then.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Let's keep it in this room for now.<n>That way you
can use it whenever<n>you feel like it.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Geez...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: You're such a handful.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Looks like we have another first-prize<n>winner!
Congratulations! You get one<n>deluxe carrot
hamburger steak!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Welcome! How many of you are<n>dining toda—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Wait, Trainer?! Are you eating ramen<n>again?
choice_data_list: No, no! I wanted to tell you I won first prize!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! It's a carrot hamburger steak!<n>Is it really
okay for me to have this?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Thanks! I'll eat it after I'm done with<n>my shift!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Say, Trainer. You didn't come all theway over here just to give me this,did you?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ahaha...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
You could've just given me it<n>tomorrow. You've
got a surprisingly<n>cute side to you.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
And so, I hand over the deluxe carrot<n>hamburger
steak to Ines Fujin.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
We got a second-prize winner! It's<n>your lucky day!
You're going home<n>with a bushel of carrots!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I receive a cardboard box packed full<n>of carrots,
which I decide to carry to<n>the student dorms. But
when I arrive...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Grrrowl...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Grrrowl...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Ugh!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I come across Oguri Cap, her stomach<n>loudly
rumbling. With each rumble,<n>she visibly winces—it
seems her<n>hunger has reached its limit.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Oh, are you hungry, Oguri?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I'll share a few with you. I<n>don't have that
many, though, so<n>keep this a secret between us,
okay?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but they'd probably be tastier<n>cooked rather
than raw. How about I<n>whip you something up?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
So that's why we're being treated to<n>a hot pot,
huh? I was surprised when<n>I suddenly got a
message saying to<n>come to your office after I finish
work.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Ines! Your trainer's cooking is so<n>delicious!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
My trainer is top-class, after all! Right,<n>I think I'll try
a bit too!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
And so, the giant box of carrots<n>vanishes in a single
night,<n>disappearing into an abyss made up<n>of two
Umamusume stomachs...

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Would you lookie here! You've won<n>the third prize!
Here's your carrot!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: A single carrot, huh? Well, it is just a<n>raffle, after all.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for helping out on short<n>notice, anyhow!
That raffle ticket was<n>going to expire after today, so
I'm<n>glad it didn't go to waste!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Let me know if you ever have a<n>spare ticket of your
own. I'll be there<n>to help you out, Trainer!
choice_data_list: I wonder if that will ever happen...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: It totally will!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Maybe.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I hand over the carrot to Ines Fujin<n>and we head
home.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, tough luck! Looks like you<n>pulled a blank one!
Take this pack of<n>tissues as a consolation prize.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>
choice_data_list: I guess luck wasn't on my side!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hello-lo, Trainer! About that raffle<n>ticket I gave you
yesterday...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hm? You're looking a bit down in the<n>dumps first
thing in the morning...
choice_data_list: I pulled a blank in the raffle...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: What?! No way?!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no, no. I didn't mean it like that! I<n>just can't
believe you're feeling<n>down because of something
so silly!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Aaah, look, I'm sorry, okay? I never<n>expected you
to feel guilty over a<n>raffle...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I end up making Ines Fujin worry<n>about me
needlessly.
